description:
FILED s483c (Opus, 2026-09-13) while probing #1621; FIXED in the same commit
(the two are one hole in the same use set, from opposite sides).

A name CAPTURED by a nested anon sub has uses the raw-verdict term walk never
classified: `Pl::VarAnnotator::_tw_expr_parse` skips `sub { ... }` blocks (the
nested-sub REGION fact owns them), and that fact records boxing EVENTS, not
read CLASSES.  #760's narrowing -- "a capture alone is not a boxing event" --
is sound for the A regime, where the raw slot holds the SAME value a box
would, and WRONG for the B regime, which COERCES what it stores.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl on 6eea8578):

    my $cr = sub { 7 };
    my $s  = "$cr";                 # a genuine stringify use -> B-str licence
    my $f  = sub { $cr->() };       # the closure's read is NEVER classified
    print(($s =~ /^CODE\(0x/ ? 1 : 0), " ", $f->(), "\n");

    perl:  1 7
    PCL :  Undefined subroutine &main::CODE(0x1) called

$cr's slot is frozen to the STRING "CODE(0x...)" by
(p-let (($cr :str (%pcl-to-string-strict <the lambda> "$cr") :captured t)),
so the closure calls a string.  The value is gone -- the #138 silent-wrong
family, at run time.

=== DONE (s483c) ===
FIX: one conjunct `!$captured` on the B-regime gate in
`Pl::VarAnnotator::_analyze_tree` ($ctx->{nested_sub}{$name} is the existing
capture fact).  A captured name keeps its box; nothing else moves.

MEASURED (with #1621, one commit): corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111 files +
6 shapes; emission-ab vs 6eea8578 over 1034 files (lib/ 22, cpan-tests/
modules 402, perl's own t/ 604, shapes 6) SAME=1034 DIFF=0 RCDIFF=0 -- the
two fixes only ever REMOVE a freeze that no corpus file earned.  Guard rows
in Pl/t/raw-verdict-01.t (the #1622 row is `#1622: ... a REAL interpolation
plus a closure call keeps the ref`), INVERSE-verified on a 6eea8578
`git archive` extraction.
subject: a name CAPTURED by a nested anon sub has uses the raw-verdict walk never classified, so the B-str freeze fires on a code ref and the value is LOST
